banking-economy.title: Banks seek clarification on implementation of RBI forex measures
banking-economy.summary: Indian lenders have requested clarification from the Reserve Bank of India regarding new currency-supporting measures. Clarifications on the treatment of cash reserves and their classification as high-quality liquid assets have also been requested.
